title: 第二十八章 解药
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
秦弦无措地看着显眼包萧姚跑远，脚步不自觉往外追了两步，才扶着只剩框架的屋门停住。

    他的手指轻轻蜷起，捏住宽大的袖口，旋即转身进屋，半蹲下身拾起复灵药的空瓶，三指捏住，仔细研究。

    终于，他在瓶底发现了一行小字：

    【回春散】

    果然不是正经东西！

    秦弦脸上难得出现了懊恼的

    索清秋和张殿司尴尬的端着饮料，一脸讪笑的接受着四个长辈的审视，脸上写满高兴的将饮料一饮而尽。

    虽然叫法不同，被称之为火影，但他的职务与工作，显然就是村长。

    在索清秋眼里，白玉京已经是他财产，用“烈焰焚天”来清屏自然不合适。

    而齐皇自己更是天资绝顶，在伍公的精心培养下，也是在十五岁，才达到先天的。
content_en:
Qin Xian watched helplessly as Xiao Yao, the conspicuous person, ran away. He unconsciously took two steps outside and then stopped holding the door with only its frame remaining.

He curled his fingers slightly and pinched the wide cuffs. He immediately turned around and entered the room. He squatted down and picked up the empty bottle of the rejuvenating elixir. He held it with three fingers and studied it carefully.

Finally, he found a line of small writing on the bottom of the bottle:

【Rejuvenation Powder】

Sure enough it’s not serious stuff!

Qin Xian's face rarely showed an expression of annoyance.

Suo Qingqiu and Zhang Diansi held the drinks in embarrassment, accepting the scrutiny of the four elders with sneers on their faces, and drank the drinks in one gulp with joy on their faces.

Although he has a different name and is called Hokage, his position and job are obviously that of the village chief.

In Suo Qingqiu's eyes, Bai Yujing was already his property, so it was naturally inappropriate to use "Fire Burning Sky" to clear the screen.

And Emperor Qi himself was extremely talented. Under Wu Gong's careful training, he only reached innate talent at the age of fifteen.
